versions.changelog:
- Added new file: query_wrapper.py
- Removed file: skill-card.md
- Documentation updated to remove references to the --sync 参数和账号收录操作
- Overall usage, API, and output process remains unchanged

- Added English and Chinese README files for enhanced documentation (`README.en.md`, `README.md`)
- Removed the old skill card file (`skill-card.md`)
- No changes to existing functionality; documentation updates only

- Initial release of douyin-similar-account skill.
- Recommend similar Douyin accounts based on account name or ID using RedFox API.
- Provides account data, content stats, top head accounts, and in-depth analysis (similarities, differences, optimization tips).
- Supports nickname/ID queries, direct command invocation, and customizable push notification for account updates.
- All features designed for Douyin creators, operators, and marketers needing reference or competitor benchmarking.
